subject.title: fix: reject unsafe Mattermost API path segments

question: Should this security-boundary PR require controlled HTTP after-fix proof, or should a qualified maintainer explicitly override the external-contributor real-proof gate based on the source and mocked transport coverage?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and has focused regression coverage, but only a human can authorize bypassing the repository's real behavior proof requirement for an external security-sensitive PR.

options.title: Require controlled HTTP proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs showing unsafe input produces no authenticated request while a normal Mattermost API path still reaches the intended endpoint.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: A qualified maintainer may explicitly accept the source analysis and mocked pre-transport coverage without additional runtime evidence.

recommendation.title: Require controlled HTTP proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs showing unsafe input produces no authenticated request while a normal Mattermost API path still reaches the intended endpoint.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned and authored the latest security-boundary refinements, making them the best available owner for the proof decision.
